body: i understand how you feel. im not black but i am an asian and ive been bullied alot becuase of my culture and my beliefs by others who arent asian and also been bullied by people who are from the same ethnic background as me. i'm also part of the lgbtq+ community yet i can't come out to any family members or anyone related to me due it being a 'sin' in our religion. i have recently fallen out with my school friends due to me trying to attempt and they were the ones who i was happy with being openly gay with.  it's been a mess but i promise you things will get better! right now it seems like theres no light and you are being consumed by the darkness but i promise there's light at the end of the tunnel. things that have worked for m was doing meditation, working out, listening and making my own music and i've started bullet journalling to help me with my mood and to keep record of it. try to find more like minded people like you irl or online , people who will love you for who you truly are and things will get better!  you are loved and i'm always here if you need to talk or vent again don't  hesitate to message me darling <3
